test_hist_empty_data_no_inputs: test the hist method on an empty UInt8 Series returns 10 default bins with zero counts
test_hist_empty_data_valid_edges: test the hist method with explicit bin edges returns correct categories and zero counts for empty Series
test_hist_with_bin_count: test the hist method with a bin_count parameter computes correct breakpoints, categories, and counts for integer data
test_hist_with_explicit_bins: test the hist method with explicit bins list handles partial covering, first edge, and last edge cases
test_hist_floating_point_accuracy: test the hist method handles floating point edge cases and ULP boundary precision correctly
